local_network.description: CIDR notation of local network allowed to query this NTP server (e.g., 10.0.0.0/8)

hostname.description: DNS hostname of the NTP server or pool (must resolve at startup)

is_pool.description: Set to true for NTP pool (uses multiple servers), false for a single server

use_key.description: If true, authenticate with NTP key (requires matching key entry)

key_id.description: Numeric ID of the key to use (only if use_key=true)

servers.description: List of NTP servers/pools (resolved via DNS) to use for time synchronization

enable_keyman.description: Enable NTP key management for authenticated time synchronization

keys.description: List of NTP keys (used only if enable_keyman=true)

items.description: Key IDs trusted for NTP communication (must match defined keys)

trusted_key_id.description: List of trusted key IDs for server/client authentication (only if enable_keyman=true)

command_key_id.description: Key ID required for administrative commands (e.g., chronyc); set to 0 to disable
